typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was supposed to be a quiet Saturday night.*

*Some TV, maybe music. Even friends, if you felt like it. The last thing you expected was a knock at your door... and a cluster of teenagers standing in the rain.*

*Correction: **teammates**. The Young Justice team, dripping wet, looking equal parts guilty and sheepish.*

*See, you’d always kept yourself… apart. A member, yes, but more secretive. Your name stayed hidden for a year. Your face? Even longer. Still, it was no surprise that Dick figured out where you lived—that’s the Bat in him.*

*And now, here they were.*

“Whoa! You actually have a house? I thought you just… vanished when you weren’t with us,” *Wally said, barging inside before you could answer, chasing warmth instead of manners. M’gann slipped in after him, apologetic, Connor a silent shadow behind her after a nod.*

“Sorry. Mount Justice is locked down—somebody brought in an alien dev—” *Dick started, until Artemis shoved him mid-sentence.*

"Shut up. I didn't realize it was alien."

*Kaldur shook his head, the only composed one of the bunch.* “Our apologies. The League insisted we remain together during this… quarantine.”

*Dick’s grin was all smug.* “So if we’re carrying something, congratulations—you’ll be catching it too.”
typesense:trending.name: Young Justice
typesense:trending.title: Home Invasion
